newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel edge higher, cargoes remain tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel edge higher, cargoes remain tight.

text.p: NWE jet fuel were slightly higher on Tuesday in line with futures, but traders said the market was fairly quiet.
"There simply aren't very many whole cargoes available. Smaller parcels of about 10,000 (tonnes) can be found but that's about it," one trader said.
Cif cargo premiums were put at roughly Oct IPE +$35/+$37 for part cargoes and about Oct IPE +$34/+$36 for a 25,000-30,000-tonne cargo.
On the barge market, small parcels traded at Oct IPE +$26 and +$27 fob ARA. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
